name: Taste Stack
tagline: Installable design skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, with free starters and one-time paid packages.
description:
Taste Stack is a library of installable design skills for developers who build with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Each taste provides a visual identity and instructions that a coding agent can apply to a project, covering choices such as typography, spacing, color and interface composition. Users choose a style or task, review the public output previews, then follow the installation instructions for their agent.

The site offers four free starter tastes and paid packages. Free starters require an account; listed individual paid tastes cost $3.99 once. Users bring their own coding agent and model, and a skill purchase does not include a model subscription. The licence permits commercial use of resulting work, while the skill packages themselves may not be redistributed, resold or publicly shared.

Submitted by the Taste Stack team with AI assistance. This is a maker-provided product description, not an independent hands-on review. Public product and pricing information: https://tastestack.dev/ and https://tastestack.dev/pricing.
